statement_filter.description: Explicit statement-class filter for the discovery list. An omitted field keeps the earlier unfiltered request semantics (`all`).

AuditStatementFilter.description:
Product-owned statement-class filter over AuditLoader rows.

`ExcludeDoctorAndNonQuery` keeps only rows whose FE-reported `isQuery` is exactly 1 (official 3.5.14 `ConnectContext.isQueryStmt`: a `QueryStatement` or EXECUTE of a prepared query; statements that fail to parse keep the initial `true`) and whose `stmt` does not start with this product's fixed statement marker. SET/SHOW/DDL/DML rows, rows with a NULL `isQuery`, and this tool's own statements are hidden but counted.
